name: banded-tibialis-raise
instructions:
1. Attach a band to a kettlebell by threading one end through the loop.
2. Attach the free end to top of your foot and move back slightly to increase tension within the band.
3. Pull your toes toward your face as you flex the anterior portion of your calf.
4. Slowly lower the toes until you feel a stretch in the front of your shin and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
